exposure: Protection against impoverishing and catastrophic expenditures for surgical procedures
outcome: National-level results of the six indicators posed by the Lancet Commission on Global Surgery
Financial protection from impoverishing and catastrophic expenditures for caesarean section, appendectomy, external femur fixation, and laparoscopic cholecystectomy
cohort: All operative patients in Mongolia's 81 public hospitals with surgical capability, including tertiary, secondary and primary/secondary facilities, from 2006 to 2016
finding: Mongolia meets national benchmarks for access to essential surgery, provider density, surgical volume, and postoperative mortality, but significant disparities exist between regions and unequal access may be addressed by strengthening district hospitals.
mod_finding: All households were financially protected from caesarean section.
